title: Combining in situ ECCI with HR-EBSD Analysis to Understand Dislocation/Grain Boundary Interactions under Monotonic and Cyclic Loading Conditions
content: Interactions between dislocations and grain boundaries dictate the strength of polycrystalline materials and can lead to micro-crack initiation when the grain boundary is not able to accommodate more incoming shear. This behavior is especially prevalent under cyclic loading conditions, where grain boundaries often act as crack initiation sites. As a result, the study of dislocation structures near grain boundary and the associated stress field are of great interest.
